formal: A startup has offered me a product role at a salary approximately twenty percent higher than my current earnings. They have requested an answer by Friday. The plan is to accept the offer by telephone on Friday and to submit my resignation at my current employer that same afternoon, before the written contract has arrived. I am unable to determine whether the raise or the product role is of greater importance to me, and I intend to proceed with the plan regardless. I rarely bring employment decisions to you, and consulting you about a career move is unusual for me. What is your view?
